weakband_audit.normalization: Each channel mean power; covariance/lag by outer channel means; complex cross by sqrt(Lmean*Rmean). Fixed floor1e-24.

results.source_context: F3 two ascents, early/mid/late; in-sample normalized-coordinate diagnostic

decision.reason: The more converged original objective does not monotonically improve the full waveform. Explicit waveform blind spots and unobserved full-spectrum detail require stronger declared observations, not more blind iterations or harmonic reduction.
decision.next: Known-first complete-frequency/endcap observation with explicit coverage/Parseval/adjoint/edge-impulse controls; then all6 original inputs, original observer and all regressions. Existing inverse objective remains frozen. Only subsequently source-statistical sustained generation, native48k/aliasing, C, one driver and listening.
